en.headline: Wang Fuk Court buy-back deadline will not be extended, official says
en.dek: Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong confirmed nearly 95 per cent of owners have accepted the government offer, with the August 31 cutoff remaining firm and later statutory compensation expected to be substantially…
body: Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong Wai-lun said on Sunday that the deadline for Wang Fuk Court owners to accept the government’s acquisition offer will not be extended beyond 31 August.

As of Friday, 94.7 per cent of households — 1,878 units — had submitted acceptance letters, and 74.1 per cent had already signed sales and purchase agreements. About 100 households, or 5.3 per cent, had yet to respond.

Wong told a radio programme that any delay would affect the wider resettlement timetable, including flat selection under the special sales exercise expected to begin by the end of September. He noted that compensation under a later statutory process would be based on post-fire market values and therefore substantially lower than the current offer of HK$8,000 or HK$10,500 per square foot. Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho said owners who accept will receive ballot numbers in early September for a mid-month computer draw to determine selection order.

zh.headline: 黃偉綸：宏福苑收購限期8月31日不延期 近95%業主已接受
zh.dek: 財政司副司長表示截至上周五94.7%業主已簽署接受收購建議，餘約100戶，重申期限嚴肅，稍後法定收樓補償將明顯較低。
body: 財政司副司長黃偉綸周日在電台節目表示，大埔宏福苑業權收購計劃的登記期限將於8月31日屆滿，政府絕對不會延期。
截至上周五，已有94.7%、即1,878戶業主簽署接受收購建議書，當中約74.1%已正式簽署買賣合約；餘下約5.3%、約100戶尚未簽署。
黃偉綸指出，任何延誤都會拖慢整體安置工作，包括特設銷售計劃預計9月底開始揀樓。他提醒，若稍後透過法定機制收回餘下業權，補償將按當時市值計算，會明顯低於現時每呎8,000元或10,500元的收購價。房屋局局長何永賢表示，接受收購的業主將於9月初陸續收到編配號碼，9月中進行電腦隨機排序決定揀樓次序。
